name: Height-Collapse / Metric→Symmetry Attractor
summary: An operator describing the Brauer Height→0 limit: the metric degenerates (loses discriminative power along non-stable dimensions), while symmetry and invariance become dominant governing structures for validation and decision-making. Applicable to AI (robust representations, retrieval/reranking) and O.i (decision-noise reduction), with potential mappings to silicon implementations through precision, rank, and threshold control.

state_space.description: State space (embedding space, belief state, decision state, or feature manifold).

height.interpretation: Structural resolution parameter. High H: fine-grained discrimination; low H: noise suppression and invariant preservation.
height.role: Controls schedules, precision, thresholds, and rank.

metric.description: Metric tensor or distance function dependent on Height. As H→0, the metric becomes degenerate.
metric.degeneracy_condition: det(g_H)→0 as H→0, or there exists v≠0 such that vᵀ g_0 v = 0.

symmetry.description: Transformation group (augmentations) modeling equivalent variants of the same object or meaning.

formal_definitions.title: Metric / Divergence Operator
notes: g_H may be diagonal (per-dimension weights), low-rank, or a full matrix.
In hardware implementations, 𝓓_H is primarily realized through MAC (dot-product) operations and optional normalization.

formal_definitions.title: Symmetry Projection Operator (Group Averaging)
formal_definitions.equation: 𝓟_G[f](x)=∫_{g∈G} f(g·x) dμ(g) (practically: average over transformations)
notes: In machine learning: ensemble over augmentations, group pooling, or canonicalization.
In O.i: stability testing of conclusions under contextual transformations.

formal_definitions.title: Height-Collapse Operator (H→0 Attractor)
notes: Interpretation: as Height decreases, variants within the same orbit are merged; only invariant coordinates remain.
Practical implementations do not require solving the full argmin; canonicalization, pooling, and threshold-based merging are sufficient.

interpretation.core_claim: As H→0, the metric becomes degenerate and loses discriminative power along non-stable dimensions. Symmetry and invariance emerge as the dominant governing structures, causing variants within Orb(x) to be identified as equivalent under the metric.
interpretation.refinement: The claim is not that the metric vanishes, but that it degenerates: det(g_H)→0 or rank(g_0) decreases.

ai_applications.goal: Learn representations that remain stable under transformations (augmentations, paraphrases).
ai_applications.loss: 𝓛 = E_{g∼G}[𝓓_H(f(x), f(g·x))] with a high→low Height schedule
ai_applications.expected_effect: Reduced overfitting to non-invariant details and improved generalization.

ai_applications.goal: Fast recall using metrics followed by invariance-based reranking.
pipeline: Stage 1 (High H): ANN retrieval using cosine or Mahalanobis distance for top-K recall.
Stage 2 (Low H): symmetry projection, canonicalization, and stability checks for reranking and verification.

ai_applications.goal: Reduce Height when entropy or uncertainty becomes high.
ai_applications.rule: If entropy(p) > τ, decrease H and strengthen invariance validation.

oi_applications.model: x = s + n, and 𝓒_{H→0}(x) ≈ s
oi_applications.validity_test: Valid(a)=1 if E_{g∼G}[Δ(a;g)] ≤ ε (conclusion remains stable under framing/source perturbations).

oi_applications.goal: Drive the system toward a symmetry fixed-point when a final decision is required.
oi_applications.note: Compatible with HZSO/BZDO-style reasoning: dissolving differences to expose the underlying invariant law.

silicon_mapping.goal: Transform the Metric→Symmetry pipeline into a low-cost, high-speed, energy-efficient computational block.

blocks.name: Height Controller
mapping: High H → FP16/INT16, small τ, large k
Low H → INT8/INT4, large τ, small k

practical_notes: Height naturally maps to hardware through precision control, merge thresholds, and rank reduction.
No explicit Einstein-style metric is required; this metric exists within AI/O.i state spaces.

tests.description: A question is paraphrased or reframed. After applying 𝓟_G, the resulting representations should be closer than before projection.
tests.success_criterion: Mean d_H(z, z_g) decreases as H decreases.

tests.description: Two states differ primarily along noisy dimensions. As H→0 and τ(H) increases, the system should merge them (treat them as equivalent).
tests.success_criterion: Merge rate increases as H decreases, while invariant accuracy remains above an acceptable threshold.

recommended_defaults.metric: Cosine similarity or diagonal Mahalanobis distance

warnings: Reducing H too aggressively may cause excessive collapse and loss of necessary distinctions.
The symmetry group G must be clearly defined for the target domain.
